title: Reproducible Native Rust Evidence Manifest and SHA-256 Artifact Comparison
manifest_contract: Hash the full Rust src and tests trees, Cargo manifest and lockfile when present, frozen AETHER-216 fixture, CI workflow, and evidence tools
Hash exact observed CI log and qualification JSON bytes; missing inputs are represented explicitly
Record Git HEAD SHA and deterministic canonical JSON digest of file paths, sizes, SHA-256 values, and commit
Exclude dynamic generation time, absolute runner paths and manifest's own digest from the reproducible content digest
Fail closed if Cargo command logs, JSON report, toolchain versions, source commit, or successful native qualification result are missing
Compare manifests using actual digest inventories and source revision; record disagreement instead of selecting a convenient result
Capture manifests in GitHub Actions with an always step, including failed native builds
constraints: No independently verifiable execution evidence was retrieved from Actions in this session
Python test sources are authored, not certified as executed; offline container could not download GitHub sources for local test execution
Hash equality provides a reproducibility comparison but is not a cryptographically authenticated remote witness
Source inputs and toolchain version are documented but dependencies may still resolve differently without a verified lockfile and pinned toolchain
Original physical hardware captures and independent external custody remain 0; physical ACT HOLD
